item.title: Electoral Competition, Voting, Political Violence, and Policy Outcomes
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of The Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance focuses on the intersection of economics and politics, examining how electoral competition, voting mechanisms, political violence, and policy outcomes interact to shape economic and political systems.

Potential topics

  • Electoral competition
  • Voting behavior and analysis
  • Political violence
  • Policy outcomes
  • Economics of politics

Timeline

  • April 1, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
